       + (CAST(market_sentiment_indicators->'oscillators'->>'bbandspan' AS numeric) * 0.01)) / 3.0 
       * CASE 
           WHEN market_sentiment_indicators->'momentum'->>'techmeter' = 'Buy' THEN 1 
           WHEN market_sentiment_indicators->'momentum'->>'techmeter' = 'Sell' THEN -1 
           ELSE 0 
         END AS numeric), 2) as tss
  FROM analyticsindicators
  WHERE market_sentiment_indicators->'momentum'->>'techmeter' IN ('Buy', 'Sell')

  MAX(CASE WHEN techmeter = 'Sell' THEN tss END) as max_sell

  END) as highest_buy_strength,

  END) as lowest_sell_strength
